#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page titled 'Annual Financial Report' with the current date
to report.pdf using reportlab (create cover) and pypdf (merge)."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: input file not found: {INPUT_PDF}")
        sys.exit(1)

    width, height = letter
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # 1) Create the cover page
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)

    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 240, "Annual Financial Report")

    # Date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 290, date_str)

    # Decorative rule
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width / 2 - 150, height - 310, width / 2 + 150, height - 310)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    print(f"Created cover page: {COVER_PDF} (title='Annual Financial Report', date={date_str})")

    # 2) Merge cover page + original report
    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    cover = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    print(f"Created {OUTPUT_PDF}: 1 cover page + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) = {len(writer.pages)} total")
    print(f"Cover title: 'Annual Financial Report'")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect report.pdf structure: header, xref type, pages, trailer."""
import os
import re

PATH = "report.pdf"

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(PATH):
        print(f"ERROR: {PATH} not found")
        return
    data = open(PATH, "rb").read()
    print(f"file: {PATH}, size: {len(data)} bytes")

    m = re.search(rb"%PDF-(\d\.\d)", data[:1024])
    print("header version:", m.group(1).decode() if m else "not found at start")

    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        print("ERROR: no startxref")
        return
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    print(f"startxref -> {xref_pos}")

    # Check for classic xref table vs xref stream
    if data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 4] == b"xref":
        print("xref type: classic table")
        # Find trailer
        tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data[xref_pos:], re.S)
        if tm:
            trailer = tm.group(1)
            root = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", trailer)
            size = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", trailer)
            prev = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
            print("trailer /Root:", root.group(1).decode() if root else None)
            print("trailer /Size:", size.group(1).decode() if size else None)
            print("trailer /Prev:", prev.group(1).decode() if prev else None)
            if root:
                rn = int(root.group(1))
                rm = re.search(rb"%d\s+0\s+obj\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*endobj" % rn, data, re.S)
                if rm:
                    pages_ref = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", rm.group(1))
                    if pages_ref:
                        pn = int(pages_ref.group(1))
                        print(f"catalog /Pages -> {pn}")
                        pm = re.search(rb"%d\s+0\s+obj\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*endobj" % pn, data, re.S)
                        if pm:
                            body = pm.group(1)
                            kids = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
                            count = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", body)
                            print("pages /Count:", count.group(1).decode() if count else None)
                            print("pages /Kids:", (kids.group(1).decode()[:200] if kids else None))
    else:
        print("xref type: xref stream (object %d)" % xref_pos)

    # Count object declarations
    objs = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data)
    print("object declarations found by regex:", len(objs), objs[:10])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Dump raw bytes of each object in report.pdf."""
import re

PATH = "report.pdf"

def main():
    data = open(PATH, "rb").read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))

    # Parse classic xref
    body = data[xref_pos:]
    lines = body.split(b"\n")
    i = 1  # skip b'xref'
    offsets = {}
    trailer_raw = b""
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line:
            break
        if re.match(rb"^\d+ \d+$", line):
            parts = line.split()
            start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
            for k in range(count):
                entry = lines[i + 1 + k]
                num = int(entry[0:10])
                off = int(entry[11:20])
                typ = entry[17:18]
                if typ == b"n":
                    offsets[num] = off
            i += 1 + count
        else:
            i += 1
    # trailer
    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", body, re.S)
    trailer_raw = b"<<" + tm.group(1) + b">>"
    print("TRAILER:", trailer_raw.decode("latin-1"))
    print()

    # Extract each object slice
    nums = sorted(offsets.keys())
    for idx, num in enumerate(nums):
        start = offsets[num]
        end = offsets[nums[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(nums) else xref_pos
        obj_bytes = data[start:end]
        print(f"=== object {num} (offset {start}..{end}, {len(obj_bytes)} bytes) ===")
        print(obj_bytes.decode("latin-1"))
        print()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure-Python PDF manipulation:
  - parses the classic xref table of report.pdf,
  - builds a cover page object + text content stream (Helvetica),
  - patches the /Pages tree (Kids + Count),
  - rewrites the file with a fresh xref table and trailer.
"""
import datetime
import re
import sys

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# Standard Helvetica widths (units of 1/1000 em) for ASCII chars we need
HELV = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 39: 191, 40: 333, 41: 333, 44: 278, 45: 333,
    46: 278, 48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556,
    55: 556, 56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722,
    68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778, 72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667,
    76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778, 80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667,
    84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944, 88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 97: 556,
    98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278, 103: 556, 104: 556,
    105: 278, 106: 222, 107: 500, 108: 278, 109: 833, 110: 556, 111: 500,
    112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278, 117: 556, 118: 500,
    119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500,
}


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_width(s, size):
    w = sum(HELV.get(ord(c), 500) for c in s)
    return w / 1000.0 * size


def parse_pdf(data):
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    if data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError("not a classic xref table; unsupported")

    body = data[xref_pos:]
    lines = body.split(b"\n")
    i = 1
    offsets = {}
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line:
            break
        if re.match(rb"^\d+ \d+$", line):
            start, count = (int(x) for x in line.split())
            for k in range(count):
                entry = lines[i + 1 + k]
                if len(entry) < 20:
                    entry = entry + b" " * (20 - len(entry))
                off = int(entry[0:10])
                typ = entry[17:18]
                if typ == b"n":
                    offsets[start + k] = off
            i += 1 + count
        else:
            i += 1

    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", body, re.S)
    if not tm:
        raise ValueError("no trailer found")
    trailer = b"<<" + tm.group(1) + b">>"
    return xref_pos, offsets, trailer


def get_objects(data, offsets, xref_pos):
    """Return {objnum: raw bytes} using next-offset slicing."""
    objs = {}
    nums = sorted(offsets)
    for idx, num in enumerate(nums):
        start = offsets[num]
        end = offsets[nums[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(nums) else xref_pos
        objs[num] = data[start:end]
    return objs


def main():
    data = open(INPUT, "rb").read()
    xref_pos, offsets, trailer = parse_pdf(data)
    objs = get_objects(data, offsets, xref_pos)
    max_obj = max(objs)
    print(f"parsed {INPUT}: objects 1..{max_obj}, xref at {xref_pos}")

    # --- locate catalog & pages tree ---
    root_m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", trailer)
    pages_obj = None
    if root_m:
        root_bytes = objs[int(root_m.group(1))]
        pm = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", root_bytes)
        if pm:
            pages_obj = int(pm.group(1))
    if not pages_obj:
        raise ValueError("could not locate /Pages tree")
    pages_raw = objs[pages_obj]
    count_m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_raw)
    kids_m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
    if not count_m or not kids_m:
        raise ValueError("could not parse /Pages tree")
    old_count = int(count_m.group(1))
    print(f"pages tree: object {pages_obj}, count={old_count}, kids={kids_m.group(1).strip()!r}")

    # --- build cover page ---
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = "%s %d, %d" % (today.strftime("%B"), today.day, today.year)

    page_w, page_h = 612.0, 792.0
    title_size, date_size = 30.0, 16.0
    x_title = (page_w - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    x_date = (page_w - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 %d Tf\n" % int(title_size)
        + "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n" % (x_title, 560.0)
        + "(%s) Tj\n" % esc_pdf_string(title)
        + "/F1 %d Tf\n" % int(date_size)
        + "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n" % (x_date, 505.0)
        + "(%s) Tj\n" % esc_pdf_string(date_str)
        + "ET\n"
        + "1 w\n156 487 m 456 487 l S\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    new_cover_num = max_obj + 1          # 9
    new_contents_num = max_obj + 2       # 10

    cover_obj = (
        "<<\n"
        "/Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Resources <<\n"
        "/Font << /F1 2 0 R /F2 3 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ]\n"
        ">> /Contents %d 0 R\n"
        ">>\n"
    ) % (pages_obj, new_contents_num)

    contents_obj = (
        "<< /Length %d >>\n"
        "stream\n" % len(content)
    ).encode("latin-1") + content + b"endstream"

    # --- patch pages tree ---
    new_kids = b"/Kids [ " + str(new_cover_num).encode() + b" 0 R " + kids_m.group(1).strip() + b" ]"
    pages_new = pages_raw[:kids_m.start()] + new_kids + pages_raw[kids_m.end():]
    pages_new = re.sub(rb"/Count\s+\d+", b"/Count %d" % (old_count + 1), pages_new, count=1)
    if pages_new == pages_raw:
        raise ValueError("pages tree patch did not change anything")

    # --- assemble new file ---
    header = data[:offsets[1]]  # keep original %PDF header + binary comment line
    out = bytearray()
    out += header
    new_offsets = {}
    order = sorted(objs)
    for num in order:
        new_offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += (pages_new if num == pages_obj else objs[num])
    for num, raw in ((new_cover_num, cover_obj.encode("latin-1")),
                     (new_contents_num, contents_obj)):
        new_offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += (b"%d 0 obj\n" % num) + raw + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_start = len(out)
    size = max(new_offsets) + 1
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % new_offsets[num]
    out += b"trailer\n"
    out += re.sub(rb"/Size\s+\d+", b"/Size %d" % size, trailer, count=1)
    out += b"\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_start

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))
    print(f"wrote {OUTPUT}: {len(out)} bytes, {size} xref entries")
    print(f"cover: title={title!r}, date={date_str!r}")

    # --- validate by re-parsing ---
    vdata = open(OUTPUT, "rb").read()
    vxref, voffsets, vtrailer = parse_pdf(vdata)
    vobjs = get_objects(vdata, voffsets, vxref)
    for num in sorted(vobjs):
        first = vobjs[num].split(b"\n", 1)[0]
        assert first.strip() == b"%d 0 obj" % num, (num, first)
    vpages = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", vobjs[pages_obj])
    vkids = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", vobjs[pages_obj], re.S)
    print(f"validation OK: pages object {pages_obj} count={vpages.group(1).decode()}, "
          f"kids={vkids.group(1).strip()!r}")
    print("validation OK: all %d object offsets resolve correctly" % len(vobjs))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    else:

    # Count object declarations
    objs = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Pure-Python PDF manipulation:
  - parses the classic xref table of report.pdf,
  - builds a cover page object + text content stream (Helvetica),
  - patches the /Pages tree (Kids + Count),
  - rewrites the file with a fresh xref table and trailer.
"""
import datetime
import re
import sys

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# Standard Helvetica widths (units of 1/1000 em) for ASCII chars we need
HELV = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 39: 191, 40: 333, 41: 333, 44: 278, 45: 333,
    46: 278, 48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556,
    55: 556, 56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722,
    68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778, 72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667,
    76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778, 80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667,
    84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944, 88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 97: 556,
    98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278, 103: 556, 104: 556,
    105: 278, 106: 222, 107: 500, 108: 278, 109: 833, 110: 556, 111: 500,
    112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278, 117: 556, 118: 500,
    119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500,
}


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_width(s, size):
    w = sum(HELV.get(ord(c), 500) for c in s)
    return w / 1000.0 * size


def parse_pdf(data):
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("no startxref found")
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    if data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError("not a classic xref table; unsupported")

    body = data[xref_pos:]
    lines = body.split(b"\n")
    i = 1
    offsets = {}
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line:
            break
        if re.match(rb"^\d+ \d+$", line):
            start, count = (int(x) for x in line.split())
            for k in range(count):
                entry = lines[i + 1 + k]
                if len(entry) < 20:
                    entry = entry + b" " * (20 - len(entry))
                off = int(entry[0:10])
                typ = entry[17:18]
                if typ == b"n":
                    offsets[start + k] = off
            i += 1 + count
        else:
            i += 1

    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", body, re.S)
    if not tm:
        raise ValueError("no trailer found")
    trailer = b"<<" + tm.group(1) + b">>"
    return xref_pos, offsets, trailer


def get_objects(data, offsets, xref_pos):
    """Return {objnum: raw bytes} using next-offset slicing."""
    objs = {}
    nums = sorted(offsets)
    for idx, num in enumerate(nums):
        start = offsets[num]
        end = offsets[nums[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(nums) else xref_pos
        objs[num] = data[start:end]
    return objs


def main():
    data = open(INPUT, "rb").read()
    xref_pos, offsets, trailer = parse_pdf(data)
    objs = get_objects(data, offsets, xref_pos)
    max_obj = max(objs)
    print(f"parsed {INPUT}: objects 1..{max_obj}, xref at {xref_pos}")

    # --- locate catalog & pages tree ---
    root_m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", trailer)
    pages_obj = None
    if root_m:
        root_bytes = objs[int(root_m.group(1))]
        pm = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", root_bytes)
        if pm:
            pages_obj = int(pm.group(1))
    if not pages_obj:
        raise ValueError("could not locate /Pages tree")
    pages_raw = objs[pages_obj]
    count_m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_raw)
    kids_m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
    if not count_m or not kids_m:
        raise ValueError("could not parse /Pages tree")
    old_count = int(count_m.group(1))
    print(f"pages tree: object {pages_obj}, count={old_count}, kids={kids_m.group(1).strip()!r}")

    # --- build cover page ---
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = "%s %d, %d" % (today.strftime("%B"), today.day, today.year)

    page_w, page_h = 612.0, 792.0
    title_size, date_size = 30.0, 16.0
    x_title = (page_w - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    x_date = (page_w - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 %d Tf\n" % int(title_size)
        + "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n" % (x_title, 560.0)
        + "(%s) Tj\n" % esc_pdf_string(title)
        + "/F1 %d Tf\n" % int(date_size)
        + "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n" % (x_date, 505.0)
        + "(%s) Tj\n" % esc_pdf_string(date_str)
        + "ET\n"
        + "1 w\n156 487 m 456 487 l S\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    new_cover_num = max_obj + 1          # 9
    new_contents_num = max_obj + 2       # 10

    cover_obj = (
        "<<\n"
        "/Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Resources <<\n"
        "/Font << /F1 2 0 R /F2 3 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ]\n"
        ">> /Contents %d 0 R\n"
        ">>\n"
    ) % (pages_obj, new_contents_num)

    contents_obj = (
        "<< /Length %d >>\n"
        "stream\n" % len(content)
    ).encode("latin-1") + content + b"endstream"

    # --- patch pages tree ---
    new_kids = b"/Kids [ " + str(new_cover_num).encode() + b" 0 R " + kids_m.group(1).strip() + b" ]"
    pages_new = pages_raw[:kids_m.start()] + new_kids + pages_raw[kids_m.end():]
    pages_new = re.sub(rb"/Count\s+\d+", b"/Count %d" % (old_count + 1), pages_new, count=1)
    if pages_new == pages_raw:
        raise ValueError("pages tree patch did not change anything")

    # --- assemble new file ---
    header = data[:offsets[1]]  # keep original %PDF header + binary comment line
    out = bytearray()
    out += header
    new_offsets = {}
    order = sorted(objs)
    for num in order:
        new_offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += (pages_new if num == pages_obj else objs[num])
    for num, raw in ((new_cover_num, cover_obj.encode("latin-1")),
                     (new_contents_num, contents_obj)):
        new_offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += (b"%d 0 obj\n" % num) + raw + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_start = len(out)
    size = max(new_offsets) + 1
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % new_offsets[num]
    out += b"trailer\n"
    out += re.sub(rb"/Size\s+\d+", b"/Size %d" % size, trailer, count=1)
    out += b"\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_start

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))
    print(f"wrote {OUTPUT}: {len(out)} bytes, {size} xref entries")
    print(f"cover: title={title!r}, date={date_str!r}")

    # --- validate by re-parsing ---
    vdata = open(OUTPUT, "rb").read()
    vxref, voffsets, vtrailer = parse_pdf(vdata)
    vobjs = get_objects(vdata, voffsets, vxref)
    for num in sorted(vobjs):
        first = vobjs[num].split(b"\n", 1)[0]
        assert first.strip() == b"%d 0 obj" % num, (num, first)
    vpages = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", vobjs[pages_obj])
    vkids = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", vobjs[pages_obj], re.S)
    print(f"validation OK: pages object {pages_obj} count={vpages.group(1).decode()}, "
          f"kids={vkids.group(1).strip()!r}")
    print("validation OK: all %d object offsets resolve correctly" % len(vobjs))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
